decision.explanation: The original sources consistently describe Lee Seung-hoon as a South Korean speed skater, with detailed records of his achievements in both short track and long track speed skating. While documents D4S1–D4S5 and D5S1–D5S3 mention 'basketball,' these appear to be either errors or unrelated referents (not the same Lee Seung-hoon). Document D6S1–D6S4 refers to a different individual, Lee Seung-hoon (boxer), born in 1960, clearly distinguishing him from the speed skater born in 1988. Therefore, the only valid and supported association is with speed skating.
